title: The Secret of the Stone Wall
next_chapter_hook: Where does Chen Xuan's prophecy spanning ten thousand years lead? As the gears of fate begin to turn, Chen Ji will discover that what he faces is not merely a chess game of the Heavenly Dao, but an ultimate choice concerning the survival of all living beings...

text.content: The tremors from the depths of the altar grew increasingly violent. Chen Ji's footsteps faltered as an indescribable sense of oppression surged from all directions. The entity sealed for millennia seemed like an awakening ancient beast, gazing at him through endless darkness. A dormant power within his bloodline was roused, forming a strange resonance with that oppression. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, carrying a rare gravity: 'It has sensed you.' Chen Ji's gaze darkened, yet he did not retreat. Instead, he quickened his pace, moving deeper toward the source of that oppression.

The corridor opened into a vast underground stone chamber. At its center stood a white jade stone wall, roughly thirty feet high, its surface flowing with faint silver patterns that writhed like living things. Countless ancient seal characters densely carved the wall, their strokes simple yet powerful, faintly exuding a chilling prestige that struck fear into the heart. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—those inscriptions were all too familiar to him, their brushwork matching exactly the Tianji Record Fragment.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing slowly walked to the stone wall, her delicate hand gently stroking the ancient seal characters, her brow slightly furrowed. Her fingertip paused at a certain position, her expression becoming extremely complex. 'These characters... were recorded in the classics of my Holy Sect.' She turned around, her violet eyes fixed directly on Chen Ji. 'Chen Ji, just what is your origin?'

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer her question. Instead, he slowly approached the stone wall. When he drew within three feet, the silver patterns on the wall suddenly erupted into violent jumping. A gentle yet irresistible force surged from the characters, lifting him slowly into the air until his line of sight aligned with the wall's center. Ye Qing's face changed drastically. As she was about to intervene, that force sent her stumbling back several steps. 'Don't move.' Mo Xiansheng's voice resonated in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. 'This is the bloodline authentication left by Chen Xuan... The person he was waiting for has finally arrived.'

The characters on the stone wall began glowing slowly, line after line of golden seal characters floating before Chen Ji's eyes, as if an invisible hand were decoding them solely for him. He read word by word, his heartbeat accelerating. At the very top of the stone wall were five large characters—'Origin of the Tianji Record'—and below was a dense account of text. Chen Ji finally understood that the Tianji Record was not a divine object born naturally from heaven and earth, but a treasure personally refined by a great power called 'Chen Xuan.' Chen Xuan, with a mortal body, reversed fate and created the Tianji lineage ten thousand years ago, seeking to peer into the mysteries of the Heavenly Dao's operation.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Xuan?!' Ye Qing cried out involuntarily, 'Impossible... That figure from legend should have perished ten thousand years ago!' She stared死死 at Chen Ji's back, her voice trembling slightly. 'The creator of the Tianji Record... Chen family's ancestor... Chen Ji, do you even know what you carry on your shoulders?'

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer Ye Qing's question. His entire attention was captured by a passage of text at the bottom of the stone wall. It was a prophecy, its ink as crimson as blood, as if written with his very life: 'Ten thousand years later, my bloodline shall return to this place.，届时天机重聚，棋局颠覆，然则代价亦将降临。吾留此言，望后人谨记——天道之下皆为棋，唯执棋者可破局，亦唯执棋者可入局。切记，切记。' 'Millennia later, my blood will return here.届时天机重聚，棋局颠覆，然则代价亦将降临。吾留此言，望后人谨记——天道之下皆为棋，唯执棋者可破局，亦唯执棋者可入局。切记，切记。'

dialogue.content: Just as Chen Ji finished reading this prophecy, an aged yet majestic voice exploded in his mind: 'Found you, the last bloodline of the Chen family.' That voice carried no emotion whatsoever, yet it made Chen Ji's soul tremble. The Eye of Heavenly Dao—that existence standing above all—had actually established a direct connection with him at this moment! Chen Ji was frozen stiff, cold sweat beading on his forehead. Mo Xiansheng's urgent voice rang out: 'It's locating you! Break the connection quickly!'

text.content: Chen Ji fiercely bit through his tongue, forcibly severing that bizarre connection with searing pain. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice cut off abruptly, but the silver patterns on the stone wall had completely dimmed at this moment, as if some force had been exhausted. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again, carrying a hint of exhaustion: 'Fortunately you reacted quickly... But it has already captured a trace of your aura. From now on, whenever you use the Tianji Record's abilities, it can pinpoint your location.' Chen Ji slowly landed, his expression betraying nothing, but the knuckles gripping the Tianji Record Fragment had turned white.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's gaze toward Chen Ji had completely changed now—beyond shock, there was a new appraisal and... wariness. 'Chen Xuan's prophecy... bloodline returning after ten thousand years...' She murmured to herself, then suddenly laughed coldly. 'It seems my initial decision to cooperate with you was truly wise.' She stepped forward, her violet eyes flickering with complex light. 'Chen Ji, there's something I must tell you—my Holy Sect has been searching for Chen Xuan's ruins for thousands of years. You think there's a reason we appeared here?'

text.content: Ye Qing's words made the atmosphere in the stone chamber abruptly tense. She ignored Chen Ji's increasingly cold gaze, continuing on her own: 'When Chen Xuan fell ten thousand years ago, he left behind something capable of shaking the very foundations of the Heavenly Dao. Our Holy Sect searched for thousands of years without finding its whereabouts.' Her gaze fell on the now-dimmed stone wall. 'Until three years ago, we finally calculated that Chen Xuan's ruins lie beneath this ancient altar. And today... you appeared, bringing the Chen family bloodline straight to our door.'

choice.prompt: Ye Qing revealed the secret that the Holy Sect had been searching for Chen Xuan's ruins for thousands of years, and she clearly knew far more inside information. At this moment, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Since you've already been exposed, might as well seize the opportunity to extract more intelligence. Ye Qing knows far more than she's revealing.
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might turn your probing to her advantage

dialogue.content: Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, a meaningful smile curling her lips. 'You're quite composed.' She lowered her voice. 'The thing Chen Xuan left behind is called the 'Origin of Heavenly Secrets.' It's the original core component of the Tianji Record. Only with it can the incomplete Tianji Record become truly complete. But at the same time... it's a double-edged sword.' She paused. 'Those who can peer into the source of the Heavenly Dao have never met good ends.'

choices.description: Ye Qing knows too much, which is suspicious. Don't commit to anything yet—observe her true intentions.

text.content: Chen Ji turned away expressionlessly, continuing to study the remaining text on the stone wall, as if Ye Qing's words were merely wind passing by his ears. Ye Qing frowned, finding herself increasingly unable to see through this young man. He only had Foundation Building cultivation, yet possessed composure that allowed him to exchange blows with her without falling behind. This feeling made her uncomfortable, yet also made her more certain—cooperating with Chen Ji was the correct choice.

choices.description: Since Ye Qing wants to use him, why not use Ye Qing in return? Since the Demonic Path is also searching, might as well borrow her hand to gain more information.
choices.visible_cost: May be outmaneuvered by Ye Qing
choices.risk_hint: Risks of cooperating with the Demonic Path are extremely high
choices.process_label: 以退为进化被动为主动

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, and that smile made Ye Qing shiver inexplicably. 'Holy Maiden Ye, since you and I are partners, why speak so distantly?' He turned around, truly meeting her eyes for the first time. 'The thing you've searched for a thousand years is right before us. The question is—how do you plan to explain to Holy Sect headquarters why you failed to seize it?' Ye Qing's pupils contracted sharply. Was he... threatening her?

text.content: Just as the atmosphere in the stone chamber dropped to freezing point, Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly sounded in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, carrying rare excitement: 'Found it... the second page! Chen Xuan left a postscript on the back of the stone wall!' Chen Ji's gaze flickered. He calmly circled around the stone wall to its backside. As expected, the back of the stone wall was also covered with text, but it was covered by a faint light membrane that ordinary people simply could not see. Without Mo Xiansheng's guidance, he would never have discovered this secret.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gazed at the text on the stone wall's backside. Those ancient seal characters seemed alive, slowly materializing before his eyes. Chen Xuan's postscript recorded the hidden connections between the Tianji Record Fragments, along with a shocking secret—the Tianji Record comprised nine pages, scattered across the world. Each page sealed a portion of Chen Xuan's memories and power. Only by gathering all fragments could one glimpse the Tianji Record's true complete form. And the ninth page... was hidden in the deepest part of this altar!

text.content: However, the final passage of the postscript caused Chen Ji's heart to sink completely. Chen Xuan wrote: 'I devoted my entire life's effort to refining the nine pages of the Tianji Record, intending to break the heavens' game. Yet the Heavenly Dao cannot be deceived. I transgressed the taboo and shall surely face heavenly retribution. My successor, unless you are favored by fate, never seek the ninth page. Otherwise... you shall fall into eternal doom.' Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a long moment before speaking slowly: 'Chen Xuan foresaw today ten thousand years ago... Or rather, he arranged all of this precisely to wait for someone who could break the Heavenly Dao's chess game.'

choice.prompt: Chen Xuan's warning hung like a sword overhead, yet the ninth page lay right before his eyes. As the heir of the Chen family's bloodline, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Since fate has already pushed him here, avoidance will only let enemies gain the upper hand. How can one obtain a tiger cub without entering the tiger's den!
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the ninth page of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Defying Chen Xuan's warning, consequences unknown

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made his decision. Since the Heavenly Dao had already set its sights on him, he had no path of retreat. Rather than waiting for death, he would take the initiative! He walked toward the depths of the stone chamber, where an obscure restriction lay—the entrance to the altar's deepest level. Ye Qing watched his retreating figure, wanting to speak yet hesitating, and ultimately followed. Whatever Chen Ji intended to do, she had to witness it personally—it concerned the Holy Sect's thousand-year-long wish.

choices.description: Chen Xuan's warning was by no means exaggeration. The Eye of Heavenly Dao has already locked onto him. Advancing deeper now is too dangerous.
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing or others might seize it first

text.content: Chen Ji turned and walked toward the stone chamber's exit. 'Chen Ji, have you gone mad?!' Ye Qing exclaimed incredulously. 'The ninth page is right before your eyes, yet you're going to give up?' Chen Ji's footsteps did not stop. His voice was indifferent: 'If the Holy Maiden wishes to court death, feel free to go alone. Chen Ji is merely a useless waste, with no capital to take such risks.' Ye Qing clenched her teeth in frustration, yet could only follow. She knew that without Chen Ji's bloodline, the restriction on the ninth page of the Tianji Record could never be broken.

choices.description: Ye Qing wants the ninth page, and he needs her cover and resources. Each taking what they need is the foundation for lasting cooperation.
choices.visible_cost: Must share a portion of the benefits

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly stopped in his tracks, turning to look at Ye Qing. 'The Holy Maiden wants the ninth page, and I want to leave here alive.' His voice carried not a trace of emotion. 'How about we make a deal—you help me counter the Heavenly Dao's surveillance, and after success, the contents of the ninth page are shared between us.' Ye Qing froze for a moment, then laughed coldly: 'Share? You've got fine calculations.' But after沉吟片刻, she still nodded. 'Deal. But if you dare deceive me...' A fierce glint flashed in her violet eyes. 'The consequences, you know.'

text.content: The moment Chen Ji and Ye Qing reached their agreement, a violent tremor suddenly rang out from the stone chamber's ceiling. Rocks and debris rained down, and the entire altar seemed to be shaking. Ye Qing's face changed drastically: 'Bad! Someone has triggered the outer restrictions!' Chen Ji's gaze sharpened. His spiritual sense instantly probed beyond the stone chamber. In his perception, at least three powerful auras were rapidly approaching—each far surpassing Foundation Building, at least at the Golden Core realm!

Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again, carrying urgency: 'It's Tianqing Sect. At least two Golden Core realm elders... and another aura, faint and elusive, but I recognize that feeling.' He paused, his tone becoming extremely grave. 'It's Ling Yuan. That old fox actually came personally.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—Ling Yuan, the old sect master of Tianqing Sect, the transmission candidate whom the Tianji Record had skipped over. His appearance here now was no coincidence!

Three factions, gathered at the altar. Demonic Path Holy Maiden Ye Qing, Tianqing Sect's old sect master Ling Yuan, and Chen Ji, the Chen family bloodline bearing the Tianji Record Fragment. The text on the stone wall was still there, Chen Xuan's arrangement from ten thousand years ago was gradually unveiling the truth. And Chen Ji, standing at the center of all this, felt unprecedented loneliness and crisis. Mo Xiansheng had said—the more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the fatal backlash of fate. Now he had not only obtained crucial intelligence about Chen Xuan, but had also inadvertently drawn the Eye of Heavenly Dao's attention... This game of chess, he was already a involuntary participant.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly clenched his fists. That weak废物mask had long since vanished, replaced by depths of cold indifference and calculation. Ling Yuan's arrival was opportune... He had originally worried about finding no opportunity to test this old sect master's true stance, but now that worry was unnecessary. 'Holy Maiden Ye,' Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm, 'If I said I have a way for both of us to leave here alive, would you believe me?'
